blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Despite substantial progress across downstream applications, vision–language models (VLMs) remain susceptible to language bias , often prioritizing linguistic cues over visual evidence and consequently producing incorrect predictions.
Prior studies have proposed various approaches to understanding and mitigating language bias in VLMs, yet their findings often conflict due to the difficulty of tracing how language bias propagates within black-box VLMs .
Building on the word completion task, we trace how language bias propagates through VLM inference by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages to trace the propagation of language bias; and (2) examining how two key factors underlying language bias, i.e., linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage , evolve across these stages and ultimately give rise to incorrect predictions.
The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the language model component of a VLM and represents the origin of language bias, whereas cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues cover the visual content.
By decomposing inference into four stages and characterizing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage across these stages, we propose a systematic framework for tracing the propagation of language bias throughout the inference process; and uncover the underlying mechanism of language bias by revealing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage.
blocks.zh:
尽管在下游应用上取得了长足的进步,但视觉-语言模型(VLMs)仍然容易受到语言偏见的影响,往往将语言提示置于视觉证据之上,从而产生不正确的预测。
先前的研究提出了各种理解和减轻VLM语言偏差的方法,然而,由于难以追踪语言偏差如何在黑盒VLM中传播,其发现往往有冲突.
在 " 完成 " 任务的基础上,我们通过VLM推论跟踪语言偏差是如何传播的:(1) 提出一个诊断框架,将推论过程分解为四个不同但相互依存的阶段,以跟踪语言偏差的传播情况;(2) 审查语言偏差背后的两个关键因素,即语言前科和跨模式覆盖,如何在这些阶段演变并最终导致不正确的预测。
语言学前期抓住了由VLM语言模型组成部分引起的统计偏差的强度,代表了语言偏差的起源,而跨模式覆盖则衡量语言暗示覆盖视觉内容的程度.
通过将推论分为四个阶段,并描述语言学前科和跨模式覆盖之间的相互作用,我们建议建立一个系统框架,以追踪在整个推论过程中语言偏差的传播情况;通过揭示语言学前科和跨模式覆盖之间的相互作用,揭示语言偏差的基本机制。

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example of language bias in VLMs: predictions from the underlying LLM can dominate the output, even when they conflict with the visual input.
blocks.zh: 图1:VLMs中语言偏差的例子:基础LLM的预测可以主导输出,即使它们与视觉输入相冲突.

blocks.en:
Vision–Language Models (VLMs) integrate a powerful Large Language Model (LLM) with a vision encoder to support tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and visually grounded dialogue.
However, this architectural design can also introduce language bias , causing models to prioritize linguistic cues over visual evidence and potentially produce incorrect predictions ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Deng et al., 2025 ) .
For example, as illustrated in Figure 1 , given the caption
“ Some women are playing on the beach .” a VLM may predict volleyball for the blank, consistent with a strong linguistic
preference induced by the surrounding text.
However, the image shows that the women are playing soccer , while
the men are playing volleyball .
Understanding why linguistic cues can override task-relevant visual
evidence is therefore central to reliable multimodal understanding.
blocks.zh:
Vision - Language Models(VLMs)将强大的大语言模型(LLM)与视觉编码器融合起来,支持图像字幕,视觉问答,视网膜对话等任务.
然而,这种建筑设计也可能引入语言偏差,导致模型将语言提示置于视觉证据之上,并可能产生不正确的预测(Liu等人,2025b;Deng等人,2025年)。
例如,如图1所示,标题
“有些妇女在海滩上玩耍。
由周围文本诱导的偏好。
然而,这张照片表明,妇女正在踢足球,而妇女则在踢足球。
男人们在打排球。

因此,证据对于可靠的多式联运理解至关重要。

blocks.en:
There have been various studies in understanding and mitigating the language bias.
One line of research attributes biased predictions to specific architectural components .
For example, prior studies associate biased predictions with insufficient attention to visual information and show that amplifying attention to image tokens can mitigate hallucinations ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) .
However, other studies find that manipulating visual attention does not necessarily eliminate VLMs’ tendency to favor language bias ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Ortu et al., 2026 ) .
Another line of research hypothesizes that language bias stems from weak associations between visual and linguistic cues , and seeks to mitigate such bias by strengthening these cross-modal associations, reporting improvements in hallucination mitigation for visual reasoning ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
But this approach fails in other tasks ( Geigle et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
To understand the mechanisms underlying language bias, a prominent line of research leverages counterfactual data by constructing visual content that contradicts linguistic cues and examining how VLMs respond to such conflicting multimodal inputs ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025 ) .
However, this line of research relies heavily on the assumption that the multimodal data-generating function underlying VLMs can adequately account for counterfactual data, an assumption that remains unverified ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Jeong et al., 2026 ) .
More discussion about related works is available in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh:
在理解和减轻语言偏差方面进行了各种研究。
一线研究将偏颇的预测归因于特定的建筑构件.
例如,先前的研究将偏颇的预测与对视觉信息的注意不足联系起来,并表明扩大对图像符号的注意可以减轻幻觉(Liu等人,2024年;Yin等人,2025年)。
然而,其他研究发现,操纵视觉注意力并不一定消除VLMs偏好语言倾向(Yu等人,2026年;Ortu等人,2026年).
另一种研究假设语言偏差源于视觉和语言提示之间的弱关联,并寻求通过强化这些跨模式关联来缓解这种偏差,报告视觉推理在减少幻觉方面有所改进(Chen等人,2023年;Wu等人,2026年)。
但这种方法在其他任务中失败(Geigle等人,2024年;Wu等人,2026年).
为了理解语言偏差背后的机制,一线突出的研究通过构建与语言提示相矛盾的视觉内容,并研究VLMs如何应对这种相互冲突的多式联运投入(Liu et al.,2025b;Luo et al.,2025),利用了反事实数据。
然而,这一研究线在很大程度上依赖于一个假设,即作为VLM基础的多模式数据生成功能能够充分说明反事实数据,这一假设仍未得到证实(Lin等人,2023年;张等人,2024年;Jeong等人,2026年)。
关于相关著作的更多讨论载于附录A.1。

blocks.en:
These seemingly conflicting findings, together with the difficulty of selecting appropriate analysis tools, stem from the black-box nature of VLMs , making it challenging to trace how language bias propagates throughout the inference process ( Feng et al., 2023 ) .
Toward understanding the mechanisms underlying language bias, this paper traces its propagation by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decompose the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages, providing a structured framework for tracing how language bias propagates throughout inference; and (2) focusing on two fundamental factors without relying on assumptions about specific architectural components.
In addition, we focus on the word completion task. As illustrated in Figure 1 , this task requires VLMs to predict a single word in response to a textual prompt, conditioned on the provided visual input.
This is because the target word is typically a noun or adjective, which carries substantial lexical-semantic information ( Baker, 2003 ; Baker and Croft, 2017 ) , thereby facilitating our analysis of language bias.
blocks.zh:
这些似乎相互矛盾的调查结果以及选择适当分析工具的困难来自VLM的黑盒性质,因此很难追踪语言偏见如何在整个推论过程中传播(Feng等人,2023年)。
为了解语言偏差背后的机制,本文件通过:(1) 提出一个诊断框架,将推论过程分解为四个不同但相互依存的阶段,为追踪语言偏差如何在整个推论中传播提供了一个结构化框架;(2) 侧重于两个基本因素,而不依赖于对具体建筑构件的假设。
此外,我们注重完成这个词的任务。 如图1所示,这项任务需要VLMs预测一个单词,以响应以提供的视觉输入为条件的文字提示.
这是因为目标词一般是名词或形容词,它包含了大量的词典-语义信息(Baker,2003;Baker and Croft,2017),从而方便了我们对语言偏差的分析.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed four-stage diagnostic framework, illustrating how the interplay between cross-modal coverage and linguistic priors gives rise to language bias in VLMs. The framework decomposes VLM inference into visual evidence identification (Stage 1), visual relationship identification (Stage 2), misleading visual cue exclusion (Stage 3), and final decision making (Stage 4). Across the first three stages, increasing cross-modal coverage enables the model to progressively extract and integrate visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 概述拟议的四阶段诊断框架,说明跨模式覆盖与语言学前科之间的相互作用如何导致在VLMs中语言偏差. 框架将VLM推论分解为视觉证据识别(第1段),视觉关系识别(第2段),误导视觉提示排除(第3段),以及最终决策(第4段). 在整个前三个阶段,增加跨模式的覆盖面使模型能够逐步提取和综合视觉证据。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 2 , this paper traces how language bias propagates throughout VLM inference by: (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decompose the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages: visual evidence identification ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021 ; Kamath et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023b ) , visual relationship identification ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Hou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , misleading visual cue exclusion ( Mousi et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) , and decision ( Nooralahzadeh et al., 2026 ; Wang and Xu, 2026 ) , thereby enabling the analysis of where language bias emerges during prediction. These stages serve as a functional diagnostic decomposition of the task rather than a claim that VLMs internally execute inference through the same sequential process;
and (2) identifying two key factors underlying language bias, linguistic prior and cross-modal coverage , and characterizing their interplay with our diagnostic framework.
The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the LLM component within the VLM, representing the origin of the language bias.
Cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues describe the visual content in a model-agnostic manner, thereby providing a means to evaluate the cross-modality interactions between the two modalities.
By focusing on these two factors, we avoid the challenge of making assumptions about which architectural components within black-box VLMs contribute to language bias, while our empirical observations demonstrate the effectiveness of these two factors in understanding such bias.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,本文通过:(1) 提出一个诊断框架,将推论过程分解为四个不同但相互依存的阶段:视觉证据识别(拉德福德等人,2021年;贾等人,2021年;卡马特等人,2021年;李等人,2023年b),视觉关系识别(Yukekgonul等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年a年;Hou等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年),误导视觉暗示排斥(Mousi等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Xie等人,2025年),以及决定(Noorahzadeh等人,2026年;Wang和Xu,2026年),从而能够分析预测中语言偏见的出现地点。 这些阶段是任务的一个功能性诊断分解,而不是声称VLMs通过相同的顺序过程在内部执行推论;
和(2) 找出造成语言偏差的两个关键因素,即语言先行和跨模式覆盖,并描述它们与我们诊断框架的相互作用。
语言学前曲捕捉到在VLM中由LLM元件引起的统计偏差的强度,代表语言偏差的起源.
跨模式覆盖衡量语言提示以模型不可知的方式描述视觉内容的程度,从而为评价两种模式之间的跨模式相互作用提供了手段。
通过关注这两个因素,我们避免了对黑盒VLM中哪些建筑构件会助长语言偏执做出假设的挑战,而我们的经验观察则证明了这两个因素在理解这种偏执方面的有效性.

blocks.en: Diagnostic Framework: Four-Stage Decomposition of the Inference Process. The four-stage decomposition provides a unified framework for tracing language bias and reconciling conflicting findings in prior studies. (1) Beyond association: successful inference requires not only visual–linguistic associations but also the identification of relevant visual relationships and the exclusion of misleading cues, explaining the limited effectiveness of association-based mitigation. (2) Beyond attention: the need to exclude misleading cues further shows that greater visual attention alone cannot prevent VLMs from relying on the linguistic prior.
blocks.zh: 诊断框架:推论过程的四阶分解. 四阶段分解为追踪语言偏差和调和先前研究中相互矛盾的结论提供了一个统一的框架. (1) 除了关联之外:成功的推论不仅需要视觉-语言关联,而且还需要确定相关的视觉关系和排除误导提示,说明基于关联的缓解效果有限。 (2) 除了注意之外:排除误导提示的必要性进一步表明,仅靠视觉上的注意并不能阻止VLMs依赖语言上的先.

blocks.en: Interplay between Linguistic Prior and Cross-Modal Coverage. Their interplay across the four stages reveals how linguistic priors diminish the effects of cross-modal coverage and ultimately lead to language bias. (1) Cross-modal coverage facilitates progression: higher cross-modal coverage is associated with progression to later inference stages. (2) Linguistic priors create an perceptron–decision gap: they can diminish the benefits of cross-modal coverage before the decision stage, allowing correctly recognized visual evidence to be overridden in the final decision.
blocks.zh: 语言前期和跨模式覆盖之间的互演. 它们跨越四个阶段的相互作用表明,语言学前科如何减少跨模式覆盖的影响,并最终导致语言偏差。 (1) 跨模式覆盖有利于进展:跨模式覆盖度较高与后推阶段相关。 (2) 语言学前科造成了一种认知-决定差距:它们可以减少在决定阶段之前跨模式覆盖的好处,从而允许在最后决定中推翻正确承认的视觉证据。

blocks.en: 2.1 A Four-Stage Diagnostic Framework
blocks.zh: 2.1 四阶段诊断框架

blocks.en:
Examining how language bias propagates during VLM inference is challenging due to the black-box nature of VLMs.
Motivated by prior work on the mechanistic analysis of VLMs, we introduce a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four stages.
We provide empirical evidence showing that our framework can effectively distinguish multimodal examples exhibiting language bias from those without such bias.
Figure 3 illustrates what each stage measures in our four-stage diagnostic framework, as detailed below:
blocks.zh:
由于VLMs的黑盒性质,审查VLM推论期间语言偏差如何传播具有挑战性.
以先前对VLM的机械分析工作为动力,我们引入了一个将推论过程分解为四个阶段的诊断框架.
我们提供的经验证据表明,我们的框架能够有效地区分那些表现出语言偏见的多式联运例子和那些没有这种偏见的例子。
图3显示了我们四个阶段诊断框架中的每个阶段措施,详情如下:

blocks.en: S1: Visual evidence identification. S1 measures to what extent VLMs can adequately identify the visual evidence of the ground-truth noun completion, e.g., soccer. Such cross-modal association is widely regarded as a fundamental prerequisite for effective visual-language grounding ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Vong et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: S1:视觉证据识别. S1措施在多大程度上可充分识别地面真实名词完成的视觉证据,如足球。 这种跨模式联系被广泛视为有效视觉语言定位的基本先决条件(Ma等人,2023年;Vong等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: S2: Visual relationship identification. S2 measures the extent to which VLMs can correctly identify the visual relationships associated with the ground-truth answer, e.g., the relationships between women and soccer and between men and volleyball. Prior studies have demonstrated that accurately capturing such visual relationships is crucial for effective vision-language understanding and reasoning ( Hou et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023a ) .
blocks.zh: S2:视觉关系识别. S2测量了VLM能够正确识别与地面真实答案相关的视觉关系的程度,例如,女性与足球的关系以及男性与排球之间的关系. 先前的研究表明,准确掌握这种视觉关系对于有效的视觉语言理解和推理至关重要(Hou等人,2025年;Liu等人,2023a年)。

blocks.en:
S3: Misleading visual cue exclusion. Even when VLMs correctly identify the relevant visual relationships, their predictions can still be misled by distracting or conflicting visual cues. In particular, correctly recognizing a true visual relationship does not necessarily imply that the model can reject a plausible but false alternative ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Mousi et al., 2026 ) .
Building on S2, S3 evaluates whether VLMs can identify and resist misleading visual cues that may interfere with an otherwise correct visual relationship. For example, in Figure 1 , volleyball serves as the misleading visual cue.
blocks.zh:
S3:误导视觉提示排除. 即使在VLMs正确识别相关视觉关系时,他们的预测仍然可以通过分散注意力或相互冲突的视觉提示来误导. 特别是,正确承认真实的视觉关系并不一定意味着该模型可以拒绝一种可信但虚假的替代品(Sun等人,2026年;Mousi等人,2026年)。
在S2的基础上,S3评价VLM能否识别和抵制可能干扰本可正确视觉关系的误导视觉提示. 例如,在图1中,排球是误导视觉提示。

blocks.en:
S4: Decision. We further introduce a dedicated decision stage to characterize how VLMs translate multimodal evidence into a final prediction. This distinction is motivated by mechanistic studies showing that constructing task-relevant internal representations and effectively leveraging those representations for prediction are distinct processes ( Geva et al., 2023 ; Neo et al., 2025 ) . In other words, a model may form the correct internal representation without successfully translating it into the correct prediction.
In our implementation, the decision stage corresponds directly to the VLM’s final prediction of the target word completion given the multimodal input.
blocks.zh:
S4:决定。 我们还引入了一个专门的决定阶段,以描述VLMs如何将多式联运证据转化为最后预测。 这种区分的动机是机械研究显示,构建与任务相关的内部表述并有效利用这些表述进行预测是不同的过程(Geva等人,2023年;Neo等人,2025年)。 换句话说,一个模型可能形成正确的内部代表,而不成功地将其转化为正确的预测.
在执行过程中,决定阶段直接对应VLM根据多式联运投入对目标词完成的最后预测。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we regard the first three stages associated with visual cues as the visual evidence perception process, which characterizes how VLMs perceive and extract evidence from visual inputs. We then focus on the decision stage, investigating how the perceived visual evidence can be leveraged to prevent the propagation of language bias.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们认为与视觉提示有关的前三个阶段是视觉证据感知过程,它描述VLMs如何看待并从视觉输入中提取证据. 然后,我们侧重于决策阶段,调查如何利用所看到的视觉证据来防止语言偏见的传播。

blocks.en: 2.2 EVALUATION OF VLM PERFORMANCE AT EACH STAGE
blocks.zh: 2.2 评价不同阶段的VLM绩效

blocks.en: Following prior work on prompt-based probing of multimodal models ( Salin et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2025 ) , we use natural language probes to evaluate VLM performance at each stage of our diagnostic framework.
blocks.zh: 此前曾就快速验证多式联运模型进行过工作(Salin等人,2022年;Cao等人,2022年;Zhao等人,2024年;Zhou等人,2025年;Hou等人,2025年),我们使用自然语言探测器在我们诊断框架的每个阶段评价VLM性能.

blocks.en:
Example 2.2 illustrates the probing questions for the example shown in Figure 1 . The probing questions are designed to be straightforward and directly derived from the definition of each stage.
For S1 (visual evidence identification), we directly probe whether the ground-truth word is visually present in the image. Both S2 and S3 contain two probing questions. For S2 (visual relationship identification), the questions assess whether the VLM can identify the correct visual relationship associated with the ground-truth completion. In contrast, S3 probes potentially misleading visual relationships, for which the expected answer is No , allowing us to examine whether visually salient but irrelevant evidence biases the model’s reasoning. Finally, for S4, we directly evaluate the VLM’s output given the complete multimodal input.
The complete prompt templates and additional examples are provided in
Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: 2.4 Cross-modal Coverage
blocks.zh: 2.4 跨模式覆盖

blocks.en:
Cross-modal coverage measures how much of the visual cues relevant to the ground-truth word completion is already expressed in the textual input.
However, identifying which visual cues are relevant to the ground-truth completion is non-trivial.
An image typically contains more visual information than can be captured by a textual description ( Tavakoli et al., 2017 ; Ilinykh et al., 2018 ; Kreiss et al., 2022 ; Chan et al., 2023 ) , textual descriptions are selective, verbalizing only a subset of the visual content rather than describing everything in the image.
We therefore employ human annotators to identify visual cues relevant to the ground-truth completion and determine which of these cues are already expressed in the textual input.
blocks.zh:
跨模式覆盖测量了与地面真实字的补全有关的视觉提示在文字输入中已经表示多少。
然而,确定哪些视觉提示与地面真相的完成相关是非三角性的。
图像一般包含比文字描述能捕捉到的更多视觉信息(Tavakoli等人,2017年;Ilinykh等人,2018年;Kreiss等人,2022年;Chan等人,2023年),文字描述有选择性,只口头描述视觉内容的一个子集,而不是描述图像中的一切.
因此,我们利用人的注释员来识别与地面真实性完成有关的视觉提示,并确定哪些提示已经在文字输入中表达。

blocks.en:
To estimate cross-modal coverage, we develop a three-step annotation pipeline, as illustrated in Figure 4 .
First, we prompt off-the-shelf LLMs to verbalize the visual cues present in the visual input, providing candidate cues for subsequent annotation.
Second, given the visual input, textual input, and ground-truth word completion, human annotators identify the verbalized visual cues relevant to the ground-truth completion and add any relevant cues missed during the verbalization step. We denote the number of relevant visual cues by N V r N^{r}_{V} .
Finally, annotators determine which of these relevant visual cues are already expressed in the textual input, and we denote the number of such covered cues by N L r N^{r}_{L} .
This procedure allows us to distinguish between relevant visual cues that are already covered by the textual input and those that remain available only in the visual input.

第二,鉴于视觉输入、文字输入和地面真实字的完成,人文注释员确定与地面真实完成有关的口头视觉提示,并添加在口头表述步骤中错过的任何相关提示。 我们表示NV r N^{r}_{v}的相关视觉提示数。
最后,注释者确定哪些相关的视觉提示已经在文字输入中表达出来,我们表示NL r N^{r}_{L} 覆盖的这些提示的数量.
这一程序使我们能够区分文本输入已涵盖的相关视觉提示和仅存在于视觉输入中的相关视觉提示。

blocks.en: 3 Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 机械分析

blocks.en: In § 2 , we introduce the methodological preliminaries for analyzing the mechanisms underlying language bias. In this section, we first assess linguistic prior and cross-modal coverage as informative variables by testing their associations with final prediction correctness. Using our diagnostic framework, we then examine their roles in visual evidence perception and the final decision. Our findings are: (1) cross-modal coverage enhances visual evidence perception; and (2) linguistic priors can override the benefits of cross-modal coverage.
blocks.zh: 在§2中,我们引入了分析语言偏差背后机制的方法初步性. 在本节中,我们首先通过测试其关联性,以最终预测正确性,将语言上先覆盖和跨模式覆盖作为信息变量。 利用我们的诊断框架,我们然后审查他们在视觉证据感知和最后决定中的作用。 我们的调查结果是:(1) 跨模式覆盖可以增强视觉证据感知;(2) 语言学前科可以超越跨模式覆盖的好处。

blocks.en:
We evaluate five instruction-tuned VLMs from three model families: Gemma 3 (4B and 12B) ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , Qwen2.5-VL 7B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and LLaVA-OneVision 1.5 (4B and 8B) ( An et al., 2025 ) .
All models are evaluated on the same set using human-reviewed correctness that accepts semantically valid completions consistent with both inputs.

所有模型都在同一套模型上评价,采用经人审查的正确性,接受与两种投入一致的精准完成。

blocks.zh: 3.1 跨模式覆盖增强视觉证据感知

blocks.en: Prior studies have linked visually ungrounded predictions to excessive reliance on language priors ( Favero et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024a ) and insufficient use or grounding of visual evidence ( Favero et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2023 ) . Motivated by these two lines of work, we focus on two directly measurable variables for language bias: linguistic prior and cross-modal coverage .
blocks.zh: 先前的研究将视觉上无根据的预测与过度依赖语言前科(Favero等人,2024年;Lin等人,2024年a)和视觉证据使用或基础不足(Favero等人,2024年;Dai等人,2023年)联系起来。 在这两条工作线的推动下,我们侧重于语言偏差的两个直接可衡量变量:语言先行和跨模式覆盖。

blocks.en: To characterize the role of cross-modal coverage within our diagnostic framework, we examine how greater cross-modal coverage enhances visual evidence perception and enables VLMs to progress through the first three stages. To this end, we conduct statistical analyses to examine (1) whether greater cross-modal coverage improves VLM performance across the first three stages in both biased and no-bias cases and (2) whether it facilitates VLM progression from S1 to S3.
blocks.zh: 为了描述跨模式覆盖在我们诊断框架内的作用,我们研究了扩大跨模式覆盖如何增强视觉证据感,使虚拟成份在前三个阶段取得进展。 为此,我们进行统计分析,以审查(1) 扩大跨模式覆盖面是否在偏见和无偏见案件中改进了前三个阶段的VLM性能;(2) 是否有助于VLM从S1向S3发展。

blocks.en: We first examine whether cross-modal coverage and linguistic prior are systematically associated with final prediction correctness. A logistic regression jointly considering the two factors shows opposing associations with correctness: greater cross-modal coverage is positively associated with correctness for four of the five models, whereas stronger linguistic prior is negatively associated with correctness across all five models (Table 2 ). Together, these results provide statistical support for cross-modal coverage and linguistic prior as two informative factors associated with final prediction behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查跨模式覆盖和语言先行是否与最后预测正确性有系统联系。 联合考虑这两个因素的后勤回归表明相互对立的关联是正确的:五种模式中的四种模式的正确性与更大的跨模式覆盖有着积极的联系,而较强的语言先行性与所有五种模式的正确性有着消极的联系(表2)。 这些结果共同为跨模式覆盖和语言先行提供统计支持,作为与最终预测行为相关的两个信息因素.

blocks.en: We next examine how this relationship is reflected within our diagnostic framework. For this stage-wise analysis, we only include items whose ground-truth completion is a noun ( NOUN ). Noun targets allow concrete evaluation of the relevant visual concept, its relationship to the queried entity or action, and the validity of a candidate completion. Figure 5 shows that as cross-modal coverage increases, performance across the diagnostic stages generally improves, with the clearest change appearing at S3. This pattern is observed in both biased and no-bias cases, indicating that greater cross-modal coverage is associated with stronger visual evidence perception. For clarity, Figure 5 presents one representative model from each model family; results for Gemma 3 12B and OneVision 1.5 8B are provided in Appendix A.4 and show the same qualitative pattern.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查这种关系如何反映在我们的诊断框架内。 就这一阶段分析而言,我们只包括地面真实完成为名词的项目(NOUN)。 名词目标允许具体评价相关视觉概念、其与被询问实体或行动的关系以及候选人完成的有效性。 图5显示,随着跨模式覆盖面的扩大,诊断阶段的绩效普遍改善,最明显的变化出现在S3。 在偏见和无偏见的案件中都观察到这种模式,这表明跨模式覆盖面的扩大与视觉证据感的增强有关。 为了明确起见,图5提供了来自每个模式家族的一个代表性模型;附录A.4提供了Gemma 3 12B和One Vision 1.5 8B的结果,并显示了相同的质量模式。

blocks.en: At the same time, among incorrect noun-target completions, the share of errors assigned to S3 or S4 increases with cross-modal coverage. Even at higher coverage levels, difficulties with misleading visual cue exclusion and the final decision remain prominent among the errors that persist. S4 cases are particularly informative: on some items, the model answers all S1–S3 probes correctly yet completes the original caption incorrectly. We examine these cases in the next section.
blocks.zh: 同时,在不正确的名词目标完成中,分配给S3或S4的错误比例随着跨模式覆盖的增加而增加. 即使是在更高的覆盖率,在误导视觉提示排除和最后决定方面的困难仍然是持续存在的错误中的突出问题。 S4案例信息特别丰富:在有些项目上,模型对所有S1-S3探测器的答案正确却不正确地完成了原始标题. 我们将在下一节审查这些案件。

blocks.en: 3.2 The Linguistic prior overwrites visual evidence perceptron
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 语言上先覆盖视觉证据

blocks.en: In the previous section, we showed that higher cross-modal coverage is associated with better performance on S1–S3. We now examine the role of linguistic priors in the perceptron–decision gap, which describes cases in which a VLM answers the S1–S3 probes correctly but still makes an incorrect final prediction. Specifically, we ask whether strong linguistic priors can still bias the final prediction when the model has answered the visual-evidence probes correctly .
blocks.zh: 在上一节中,我们表明,跨模式覆盖率较高与S1-S3的绩效更好有关。 我们现在审查语言学前科在认知-决定差距中的作用,它描述了一个VLM正确回答S1-S3探测器但依然作出不正确的最终预测的情况。 具体来说,我们问,当模型正确回答视觉-证据探测器时,强烈的语言学前科是否仍然会偏向最终预测.

blocks.en: Before examining the counterfactual pairs, we first test whether strong linguistic priors remain associated with final-decision failures after S1–S3 have been successfully completed. As shown in Table 3 , final accuracy is consistently lower in the very-high-prior regime across all five models, even when all S1–S3 judgments are correct, motivating a closer examination of the role of linguistic prior in the final decision.
blocks.zh: 在检查反事实对之前,我们首先测试在S1-S3成功完成后,强烈的语言学前科是否仍然与最终判定失败有关. 如表3所示,在所有5种模式中,即使S1-S3的所有判断都正确,在非常优先的制度中,最终准确度一直较低,这促使在作出最后决定之前更仔细地审查语言的作用。

blocks.en: To examine the effects of linguistic priors, we (1) construct adversarial textual inputs that preserve the semantics of the original inputs but induce different linguistic priors; and (2) apply these inputs to the VLMs to analyze how changes in linguistic priors affect their final decisions. Constructing such examples is challenging because the linguistic prior must be altered without changing cross-modal coverage. To address this challenge, we restrict modifications to adjectives, prepositional phrasing and verbs , prompt off-the-shelf LLMs to generate candidate examples, and retain only those that induce a weaker linguistic prior while preserving cross-modal coverage and successful S1–S3 judgments. For models with insufficient perceptron–decision gap cases, multiple captions associated with the same image are used, with each caption reformulated and evaluated independently. One such pair is shown below:
blocks.zh: 为了审查语言学前科的影响,我们 (1)构建对抗性文字输入,保留原始输入的语义,但诱导不同的语言学前科; (2)将这些输入应用于VLM分析语言学前科的变化如何影响其最终决定. 构建这种例子具有挑战性,因为必须改变语言上先行性,而不改变跨模式的涵盖范围。 为了应对这一挑战,我们将修改限于形容词、前置词和动词,促使现成的LLMs产生候选例子,只保留那些在保留跨模式覆盖和成功的S1-S3判决的同时诱发语言能力较弱的例子。 对于知觉不足的模型 - 决定漏洞大小写,会使用与同一图像相关的多个标题,每个标题都会独立重写和评估. 其中一对如下:

blocks.en: Original: “A girl is smelling a mushroom that a woman is holding up to her.” Adversarial: “A girl is smelling a mushroom that a woman is holding in front of her.”

blocks.en: Both textual inputs express the same visual cues and therefore have the same cross-modal coverage, but they can induce different linguistic priors. We construct 100 reformulation pairs for each model, resulting in 500 pairs across the five evaluated models. Across these controlled examples, weakening the linguistic prior can change the final completion even though cross-modal coverage and S1–S3 judgments remain unchanged. Additional prior-counterfactual examples, including the corresponding changes in linguistic prior and final completion, are provided in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 两种文字输入都表达相同的视觉提示,因此具有相同的跨模式覆盖,但它们可以诱导不同的语言前传. 我们为每个模型建造了100对重排配对,结果在五个被评价的模型之间产生了500对. 在整个这些受控制的例子中,语言学前的削弱可以改变最后的完成,尽管跨模式覆盖和S1-S3判决保持不变。 附录A.5提供了更多的前事实实例,包括语言学前和最后完成的相应变化。

blocks.en: Together, the prior-stratified observation and the controlled reformulations provide complementary evidence that linguistic prior is involved in the perceptron–decision gap. Even after successful visual evidence perception, very strong linguistic priors are associated with lower final completion accuracy, and weakening the linguistic prior can change the final decision while cross-modal coverage and S1–S3 judgments remain unchanged. Our construction is intended to demonstrate that such cases can occur rather than to estimate their frequency in the full evaluation set. Because reformulation also changes the surface form of the textual input, these examples do not establish linguistic prior as the sole cause of the perceptron–decision gap.
blocks.zh: 事先批准的观察和受控重排共同提供了补充证据,证明语言先入为主涉及感知-决定差距。 即使在视觉证据感知成功后,非常强的语言学前科与最终完成精度较低相关联,语言学前科的弱化可以改变最终决定,而跨模式覆盖和S1-S3判决保持不变. 我们的构建意在表明,此类案例可能发生,而不是在整套评价中估计其频率。 由于重写也改变了文字输入的表层形式,这些例子并不将语言先定作为感知-决定差距的唯一原因.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Language bias in current VLMs may require more challenging
settings. Our results suggest that language bias is increasingly difficult to observe in stronger VLMs under relatively straightforward visual–linguistic conflicts. For example, larger models can often use available visual evidence to override misleading linguistic preferences, whereas smaller models exhibit more persistent language-biased behavior. This observation suggests that future evaluations should move beyond simple modality conflicts and consider more challenging cases, where visual evidence is incomplete, ambiguous, distributed, or requires compositional reasoning. Such settings may better reveal when strong linguistic priors continue to interfere with visual evidence even in capable VLMs.
blocks.zh:
当前的虚拟LM语言偏差可能要求更具挑战性
设置。 我们的结果显示,在相对直截了当的视觉-语言冲突下,在更强大的VLM中,语言偏差越来越难以观察到. 例如,较大的模型往往可以利用现有的视觉证据来推翻误导性的语言偏好,而较小的模型则表现出更持久的语言偏见行为. 这一看法表明,今后的评价应超越简单的模式冲突,考虑更具挑战性的案件,因为视觉证据不完整、含糊不清、分布分散,或需要结构推理。 当强语言学前科继续干扰视觉证据,即使是在有能力的VLM中,这种设置可能更好揭示.

blocks.en:
Grounding based on statistical associations may itself introduce
bias. A fundamental challenge is that current vision–language grounding is largely built upon statistical associations learned from large-scale image–text datasets. These associations provide powerful priors that enable VLMs to recognize common concepts and generate fluent responses, but they can also encourage models to rely on correlations that are not aligned with the specific visual evidence in a given instance. Therefore, language bias should not be viewed only as an undesirable error introduced after training; it may partially originate from the same statistical mechanisms that enable effective multimodal learning.
blocks.zh:
以统计协会为基础的依据本身可能采用
偏执。 一个根本性的挑战就是,目前的愿景-语言基础主要建立在从大规模图像-文本数据集中学习的统计协会之上。 这些关联提供了强大的前传,使得VLM能够识别共同的概念并产生流利的响应,但它们也可以鼓励模型依赖在特定情况下与特定视觉证据不匹配的关联. 因此,不应仅仅将语言偏差视为培训后出现的不可取错误;它可能部分源于能够有效学习多式联运的同一统计机制。

blocks.en:
The dual role of linguistic priors in VLMs. Our findings imply a fundamental “trade-off” in mitigating language bias. The linguistic prior that contributes to biased predictions under visual conflicts is also a major source of the knowledge and generalization ability provided by large language models.
Therefore, reducing language bias by suppressing linguistic influence may also limit the ability of VLMs to leverage the broad knowledge encoded in their language models. This trade-off suggests that language bias cannot be viewed as an isolated failure mode independent of the capabilities that make VLMs effective.
blocks.zh:
语言学前科在VLM中的双重作用. 我们的调查结果意味着在减轻语言偏见方面有一个根本性的“取舍”。 在视觉冲突下助长偏颇预测的语言先导也是大语言模型提供知识和通俗化能力的主要来源.
因此,通过压制语言影响来减少语言偏差,也可能限制VLMs利用其语言模型中编码的广泛知识的能力. 这种权衡表明,语言偏差不能被视为孤立的失败模式,独立于使VLM生效的能力.

blocks.en: Revisiting vision–language grounding for eliminating language bias. Our findings suggest that reducing language bias may require going beyond statistical associations as the basis of vision–language grounding. Current VLMs largely acquire semantic alignment from large-scale image–text co-occurrences, which provides strong generalization but can also entangle useful linguistic knowledge with instance-level biases. A more fundamental direction may be to construct semantic spaces that better reflect linguistic structures and cognitive principles, allowing visual and linguistic information to be organized according to their functional roles rather than their statistical correlations alone. Such grounding mechanisms could potentially reduce language bias while preserving, or even improving, the knowledge utilization ability of VLMs.
blocks.zh: 重新审视视觉-消除语言偏见的语言基础。 我们的研究结果表明,减少语言偏差可能需要超越统计协会作为愿景-语言基础的基础。 当前的VLM主要从大规模图像-文本共聚物获得语义上的对齐,这提供了强烈的概括性,但也能够将有用的语言知识与实例层面的偏见纠缠在一起。 一个更根本的方向可能是构建语义空间,更好地反映语言结构和认知原则,使视觉和语言信息能够根据其功能作用而非仅统计相关性来组织. 这种基础机制有可能减少语言偏差,同时保持甚至提高自愿人工智能的知识利用能力。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduces a four-stage diagnostic framework and two key factors, linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage, to study language bias in VLMs through a word-completion task.
Progression from the first to the final stage of our diagnostic framework reflects a transition toward unbiased prediction, with the first three stages focusing on the visual evidence perceptron.
We further provide empirical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed diagnostic framework.
Linguistic priors capture the statistical biases introduced by the LLM component of VLMs, while cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which visual cues are represented in the textual input.
Our findings associate greater cross-modal coverage with improved visual evidence perception and reveal a perceptron–decision gap , whereby linguistic priors diminish the benefits of increased cross-modal coverage, ultimately leading to language bias.
blocks.zh:
这项工作引入了四个阶段的诊断框架和两个关键因素,即语言学前科和跨模式覆盖,通过一个词补全任务来研究VLM语言偏差.
从我们诊断框架的第一阶段到最后阶段的进展反映了向无偏见预测的过渡,前三个阶段侧重于视觉证据的认知。
我们还提供了经验证据,证明拟议的诊断框架的有效性。
语言学前科捕捉了VLM中LLM部分引入的统计偏差,而跨模式覆盖则衡量视觉提示在文字输入中的体现程度.
我们的结论将更大的跨模式覆盖与更好的视觉证据感联系起来,并揭示了一个认知-决定差距,即语言学前科会减少跨模式覆盖的惠益,最终导致语言偏差。

blocks.en: Ethics statement

blocks.en: This work studies language bias in vision-language models using an existing benchmark and does not involve sensitive personal data or deployment on human subjects. Our analysis is intended to improve understanding of how linguistic priors affect multimodal predictions rather than to make claims about human behavior or social groups. Human annotations are used only for evaluating task-relevant visual and textual information and model correctness. We do not release personally identifiable information or other sensitive content.
blocks.zh: 这项工作利用现有基准研究视觉语言模型中的语言偏差,不涉及敏感的个人数据或关于人类主题的部署。 我们的分析旨在更好地了解语言学前科如何影响多式联运预测,而不是对人类行为或社会群体提出权利主张。 人的说明只用于评价与任务相关的视觉和文字信息以及模型正确性. 我们不公布个人可识别的信息或其他敏感内容。

blocks.en: Appendix A Appendix
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: A.1 Related works
blocks.zh: A.1 相关工作

blocks.en:
Behavioral studies investigate how linguistic information influences VLM predictions when it conflicts with visual evidence. Explicit textual interference can lead models to follow misleading descriptions despite contradictory images, with this preference affected by text relevance, token order, and model scale ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . Conflicts can also arise without explicit misleading text. When images contradict commonsense knowledge, models sometimes answer according to their parametric knowledge rather than the depicted situation ( Liu et al., 2025b ) .
Related work has also examined linguistic shortcuts in image–text matching. Caption likelihood can inflate retrieval performance even without visual evidence ( Lin et al., 2024b ) , while compositional evaluations reveal failures in attribute association, relational understanding, and word-order sensitivity that standard retrieval evaluations can overlook ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ) . Dedicated benchmarks further examine these behaviors through capability controls and systematic changes to the inputs.
VLind-Bench evaluates language dependence only after checking commonsense knowledge, visual perception, and commonsense bias, thereby reducing the influence of these confounding factors ( Lee et al., 2025 ) .
Counterfactual and out-of-distribution evaluations contrast cases that can be answered from linguistic priors with cases that require visual discrimination, revealing substantial weaknesses when familiar linguistic associations no longer hold ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025 ) .
Controlled image–question groups further expose language hallucination, visual illusion, and inconsistencies across related responses ( Guan et al., 2024 ) .
Together, these evaluations characterize not only whether predictions are incorrect, but also whether they follow linguistic cues, respond to changes in visual evidence, and remain consistent across related questions.
blocks.zh:
行为研究调查语言信息在与视觉证据冲突时如何影响VLM预测. 尽管图像相互矛盾,但明确的文字干扰仍可导致模型遵循误导性描述,这种偏好受到文字相关性、符号顺序和模型尺度的影响(Deng等人,2025年)。 冲突也可能在没有明确误导性案文的情况下发生。 当图像与常识知识相矛盾时,模型有时会根据其参数知识而不是所描述的情况(Liu等人,2025b)来回答.
相关工作还检查了图像-文本匹配中的语言快捷键. 即使没有视觉证据(Lin等人,2024b),Caption possible也能提升检索性能(Lin等人,2024b),而组成评价则揭示出在属性关联,关系理解,以及标准检索评价可忽略的词序灵敏度方面的失败(Yukekgonul等人,2023年). 专门的基准通过能力控制和对投入的系统改变,进一步审查这些行为。
VLind-Bench在检查常识知识,视觉感知,常识偏差后,才会评价语言依赖性,从而减少这些困惑因素的影响(Lee等人,2025年).
反事实和分配外评价将可以从语言学前科中解答的案件与需要视觉歧视的案件相比较,在熟悉的语言协会不再存在时揭示出重大弱点(Liu等人,2025b;Luo等人,2025年)。
受控图像 — 问题组进一步暴露了语言幻觉,视觉幻觉,以及相关反应的不一致(Guan等人,2024年).
这些评价的特征不仅在于预测是否不正确,而且在于预测是否遵循语言提示,对视觉证据的变化作出反应,并在相关问题上保持一致。

blocks.en:
Mitigation methods address language bias and associated hallucinations through training, decoding, additional visual evidence, and output revision.
PostAlign combines visual grounding with textual rationales and rejection of nonexistent objects to improve fine-grained visual understanding and reduce hallucinations ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
During generation, visual contrastive decoding contrasts predictions under original and distorted images to reduce reliance on statistical biases and unimodal priors ( Leng et al., 2024 ) .
Visual evidence can also be made explicit through specialist-model outputs ( Li et al., 2025 ) or image descriptions that guide subsequent decoding ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) .
At the output level, LURE revises generated descriptions using signals related to object co-occurrence, uncertainty, and position in the generated text ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
However, mitigation gains depend on the evaluation setting: adding object-grounding objectives has little to no effect on hallucination in open-ended caption generation in the experiments of Geigle et al. (2024) . We complement these evaluations by diagnosing language-biased behavior at the level of functional judgments, and then examine how these diagnostic patterns vary with linguistic prior and cross-modal coverage.
blocks.zh:
缓解方法通过培训,解码,额外的视觉证据,以及输出修正来解决语言偏差和相关幻觉.
PostAlign将视觉地面与文字原理相结合,并拒绝不存在的物体,以提高精细的视觉理解,减少幻觉(Wu等人,2026年).
在生成期间,视觉对比解码会对比原始和扭曲图像下的预测,以减少对统计偏差和单模式前传的依赖(Leng等人,2024年)。
视觉证据还可以通过专家模型输出(Li等人,2025年)或指导随后解码的图像描述来明确(Ghosh等人,2025年).
在输出层面,LURE使用与对象共发生,不确定性,以及生成文本中的位置有关的信号对生成描述进行修订(周等人,2024年).
然而,缓解收益取决于评价的设定:在Geigle等人(2024年)的实验中,在无限制标题生成中,增加物体定位目标对幻觉影响甚微。 我们补充这些评价,在功能判断一级诊断语言偏见行为,然后审查这些诊断模式如何因语言上先行和跨模式的覆盖范围而有所不同。

blocks.en: Mechanistic studies examine how internal representations and computational components contribute to model predictions.
blocks.zh: 机械学研究考察内部表达和计算成分如何为模型预测做出贡献.

blocks.en:
Information-flow analyses of factual recall distinguish the enrichment of subject representations from the extraction of queried attributes ( Geva et al., 2023 ) .
Circuit analyses identify interacting attention heads and connections that support specific behaviors through both manual investigation and automated discovery ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Conmy et al., 2023 ) .
The reliability of such explanations is itself an active area of study:
RAVEL evaluates the disentanglement of attributes in distributed representations ( Huang et al., 2024a ) , while activation-patching studies show that localization can depend on the evaluation metric and corruption method ( Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
对事实召回的信息流分析将主题表述的丰富性与被询问属性的提取区分开来(Geva等人,2023年)。
电路分析通过人工调查和自动发现确定支持具体行为的相互作用的注意力头和联系(Wang等人,2023年;Conmy等人,2023年)。
这种解释的可靠性本身就是一个积极的研究领域:
RAVEL评价分布式代表物中属性的脱落(Huang等人,2024a),而激活-射击研究表明,本地化可能依赖于评价度量衡和腐败方法(Zhang and Nanda, 2024).

blocks.en:
Other work directly intervenes on internal computation.
Inference-Time Intervention steers activations toward directions associated with truthful answers ( Li et al., 2023a ) , while DoLa exploits differences between layer-wise predictions to improve factual generation ( Chuang et al., 2024 ) .
Related analyses also examine discrepancies between internal truth-related representations and generated responses ( Liu et al., 2023b ) .
blocks.zh:
其他工作直接介入内部计算.
推论-时间干预引导激活方向与真实答案相关(Li等人,2023a),而DoLa则利用分层预测之间的差异来改善事实生成(Chuang等人,2024年)。
相关分析还审查了与真相有关的内部陈述与产生的答复之间的差异(Liu等人,2023b)。

blocks.en:
In multimodal models, causal tracing has been used to identify components involved in visual information transfer ( Basu et al., 2024 ) , while targeted attention-head interventions can shift predictions toward visual evidence or parametric knowledge ( Ortu et al., 2026 ) .
Corresponding methods strengthen visual attention ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , modify attention patterns associated with hallucination ( Huang et al., 2024b ) , steer multimodal representations ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , or separate visual and textual routes within attention heads ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
Recent studies further show that visual information may remain encoded even when the final prediction contradicts it, and that its influence on the answer depends on where and how that information is used ( Nooralahzadeh et al., 2026 ; Wang and Xu, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
在多式联运模型中,使用了因果追踪方法来识别视觉信息传输所涉及的组成部分(Basu等人,2024年),而有针对性的关注点干预可以将预测转向视觉证据或参数化知识(Ortu等人,2026年)。
相应的方法加强视觉关注 (Liu等人,2024年;Yin等人,2025年),修改与幻觉有关的注意力规律(Huang等人,2024年b),引导多模式表示方式(Liu等人,2025年a),或者在注意力头内部分别设置视觉和文字路线(Cheng等人,2026年).
最近的研究进一步表明,即使最终预测与它相矛盾,视觉信息也可能仍然被编码,其对答案的影响取决于该信息在何地以及如何使用(Noorahzadeh等人,2026;Wang and Xu, 2026).

blocks.en: A.2 Diagnostic Prompt Templates and Examples
blocks.zh: A.2 诊断快速模板和实例

blocks.en:
The diagnostic questions used in our experiments are instantiated from
shared prompt templates.
For each item, annotators identify the ground-truth concept, the competing
concept, and the visual entities and relationships associated with them.
The surface wording is adapted to the semantic type of each item, while the
